annotations.title: Get an event and its markets

description: Use when getting an event by source and event ID. Read `kind` first. Live records include all markets by default. Events archived after 10 days return a tombstone with final outcomes at the same URL. Check `quote_tier`. Label non-firm prices by tier.

event_id.description: Event ID native to the source. URL-encoded if it contains special chars.

markets_limit.description: First N live markets. markets_total counts all. Ignored for tombstones.

source.description: Single venue ID. See get_status for public IDs.
